item.title: Ex-federal minister Jody Wilson-Raybould starting treatment for breast cancer
item.description: Former federal justice minister Jody Wilson-Raybould says she will be starting treatment for breast cancer. In a post on social media, Wilson-Raybould says the treatment comes following recent surgery.

item.title: Hearings begin at Supreme Court on constitutionality of random police traffic stops
item.description: MONTREAL — The Supreme Court of Canada started hearing a case on Monday about whether it's constitutional for police to make random traffic stops, after Quebec's highest court ruled that the practice leads to racial profiling.

item.title: Classes at Laurentian University suspended as faculty, librarians go on strike
item.description: SUDBURY — Classes at Laurentian University in Sudbury, Ont., are suspended after faculty, librarians and counsellors went on strike Monday as they call for better working conditions.

item.title: Security experts sound alarm for Canada as Trump threatens to take Greenland
item.description: OTTAWA — Experts on global security and defence are warning that Canada may be forced to start "thinking about the unthinkable," as U.S. President Donald Trump ramps up his campaign to wrest control of Greenland away from Denmark.

item.title: Permanent residency applications approved for family of Ottawa mass murder victims
item.description: OTTAWA — Canada has approved permanent residency status for the Sri Lankan brother and father of an Ottawa man whose wife and four children were killed in a gruesome mass stabbing.

item.title: Layoff notices sent to thousands of federal government workers
item.description: OTTAWA — Thousands of workers across the federal public service have received notices that their jobs may be cut, many of them landing in the last week.

item.title: Gun owners have until March 31 to express interest in gun compensation
item.description: OTTAWA — The period for gun owners to declare interest in a federal program offering compensation for turning in or permanently deactivating their guns began Monday.
